Noise_sensor.label: Noise sensor
Noise_sensor.description: The uCIFI noise sensor reports a noise measurement in decibel. It also provides resources for minimum/maximum measured values and the minimum/maximum range that can be measured by the noise sensor and some specific alarms resulting from noise analysis by the device.

Gunshot_detected.label: Gunshot detected
Gunshot_detected.description: Set to True when a gunshot is detected.

Abnormal_noise_detected.label: Abnormal noise detected
Abnormal_noise_detected.description: Set to True when an abnormal noise is detected.

Sensor_Value.label: Sensor Value
Sensor_Value.description: Last or current measured value from the Sensor.

Minimum_measured_value.label: Minimum measured value
Minimum_measured_value.description: Minimum value measured by the sensor since power ON or reset.

Maximum_measured_value.label: Maximum measured value
Maximum_measured_value.description: Maximum value measured by the sensor since power ON or reset.

Minimum_range_value.label: Minimum range value
Minimum_range_value.description: Minimum value that can be measured by the sensor.

Maximum_range_value.label: Maximum range value
Maximum_range_value.description: Maximum value that can be measured by the sensor.

Reset_min_and_max_values.label: Reset min and max values
Reset_min_and_max_values.description: Reset the min and max measured values to current value.
